weaknesses: The abstract does not accurately represent the paper's contributions, as it discusses CRISPR-Cas9 instead of deep residual networks and neural ODEs.
The claims regarding the convergence of trained networks to neural ODEs after training lack sufficient empirical support and clarity.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the proposed methods or the assumptions required for the theoretical results.
strengths: The paper provides a rigorous theoretical framework connecting deep residual networks to neural ODEs, contributing to the understanding of implicit regularization.
The use of numerical experiments to illustrate theoretical findings adds empirical support to the claims made in the paper.
The exploration of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition in the context of deep learning is a significant contribution to the literature.
